title: R6: zero-dimension torch._scaled_mm GEMMs on the RTX 4060 (M/N/K = 0 with real scales, every out dtype and format pair; K = 0 with special scales)
claims: SPEC v0.1 WS2 R6; SPEC section 3.2 'Zero dimensions' (preliminary [Mk]) re-recorded
notes: Each output = one torch._scaled_mm call. params.call = the exact call (dtypes, layout, padded ld, storage offset, scale dtype/shape/value, bias, scale_result, out=, grad); params.result = the returned tensor's dtype/shape/strides/requires_grad (absent when the call raised: hw_error = '<Class>: <first line>'). Inputs a [M,K], b [N,K] are the LOGICAL operands (codes; uint16 bf16 bits for bf16 operands; mat2 = b.t() logically) whatever the physical layout; params.layout describes the physical layout. params.splitk / params.cublas come from the logged cuBLASLt call ({'S': 1} with source 'no cuBLASLt matmul call logged' when torch returned without calling cuBLASLt). Scales are fp32 bit patterns in params.scale_a/scale_b when the scale is an fp32 (or exactly representable) scalar; raw scale tensors are inputs scale_a_raw / scale_b_raw. Canary after every call (a 16x32x16 ones GEMM must give 32.0); calls without a result: 0.
